title: Futures-native ideas (own portfolio, not crypto copies) on Databento CME hourly
data_costs_splits: as Gen114 (DEV 2010-06..2017, TEST 2018..2022, HOLD 2023..2026-09; 1 tick + commission per side; returns within one instrument_id)

tests.U1 EIA crude inventory day: CL: Wednesday 10:30 ET release; sign of CL return 10:00-11:00 ET -> hold same sign 11:00-15:00 ET (post-news continuation)
tests.U2 opening-hour range breakout: ES NQ GC CL: range of the 09:00-10:00 ET bar (hourly); long above its high / short below its low on the 10:00-15:00 bar closes, flat 16:00 ET; one trade per day
tests.U3 overnight-intraday reversal: ES NQ: sign of 18:00-09:00 ET return -> hold the opposite sign 10:00-16:00 ET
tests.U4 bond-equity lead: ES: sign of ZN 09:00-10:00 ET return predicts ES 10:00-16:00 ET with the opposite sign (risk-on/off), traded in ES
tests.U5 cross-sectional momentum, 24 roots: monthly, 12-1 month return ranked within the 24 non-crypto roots, long top 6 / short bottom 6, equal risk
tests.U6 commodity curve carry (cross-section): commodities only (GC SI HG CL NG RB HO ZC ZS ZW LE HE): monthly, rank by front/second annualised roll yield, long top 4 / short bottom 4, equal risk
tests.U7 FX month-end fixing flow: 6E 6J 6B 6A: last business day, sign of month-to-date ES return -> USD direction opposite (rebalancing) from 10:00 to 16:00 ET (London 4pm fix)

rules: each idea: DEV > 0, TEST >= 0.5, HOLD >= 0.3 net; then a separate FUTURES BOOK from passers (Gen114 T1-T4 included) at equal risk, added only if it raises the book's TEST-period Sharpe without lowering HOLD. Topstep/Lucid compatibility (flat by close) reported for each.
addendum_before_data: 2026-10-19, still before any Databento data: CME equity/commodity futures halt 17:00-18:00 ET, so 'from 18:00 ET' signals (U3) start at the last price before the halt (close of the 16:00 ET bar). Same convention in Gen114 T2/T4. Code smoke-tested on synthetic random-walk files only.
